description: This header file 'webpa_attribute.h' defines interfaces for Webpa attribute management, including functions to get and set attribute values, and includes dependencies such as 'webpa_adapter.h' and 'wdmp-c.h'. It declares external functions with parameters related to attribute handling in the Webpa Abstraction Layer.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Function to retrieve attributes based on provided parameter names, count, and timestamp spans, returning attribute values, counts, and status for each input parameter.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Function to set attribute values based on parameter array, count, timestamp spans, attribute list, and retStatus for each operation.
